CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Spring-2023 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Spring-2023 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 6,950 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 16 benchmark sites in 5 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: September 2023 to November 2023). These surveys captured 227 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 16 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 2,104 cards across 123 sites, with 11.1% showing evidence of mouse activity (234 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 568 transects across 120 sites (survey period: September 2023 to November 2023), detecting active burrows in 4.9% of transects (total: 40 active burrows).
